title: Considerations About Melanocytic Nevi
content: The purpose of the  study is to analyse and to  identify specific structural characteristics of  melanocytic nevi,  to youth pacients.  Using the optical and electronic microscope, could be possible a proper describtion related melanocytic nevi. In this study play a significant role, different factors, such as genetic, epigenetic, microbiomic and proteomic factors.  Disease diagnostic management and future trends, directions are also important key points As future directions good to mention preventive and prophylactic methods.
